meta.title: Warrior Sourcing — Import from China, made simple
meta.description: Learn, find, calculate, source, import, sell: the platform that guides your China → Cameroon imports, from the first lesson to the resale.

hero.subtitle: Training, opportunities, checked suppliers, cost calculation, Mobile Money payment and step-by-step tracking to Douala or Yaoundé. All in one place.
hero.routeLabel: An order’s route: Guangzhou, warehouse, shipping, arrival in Douala

learn.title: Learn
learn.text: Courses, guides and checklists to avoid costly mistakes.

source.title: Source
source.text: Suppliers with an explained verification level, compared on the same criteria.

import.text: Payment, inspection, consolidation and step-by-step tracking.

sell.title: Sell
sell.text: Track your sales, your margin and how much capital you have recovered.

trust.title: You always know where a figure comes from
trust.text: No profit, lead time or result is ever presented as guaranteed. Every piece of information shows its nature.
trust.suppliersTitle: A supplier badge says exactly what was checked

footer.tagline: Import from China. More simply. More intelligently.
footer.legalNote: Costs and lead times shown are estimates based on your own assumptions. They are not a guarantee.

plans.title: What each plan opens up
plans.note: Nothing that warns you about a risk is ever hidden behind a subscription: a supplier incident stays visible from a free account. A subscription opens access; it does not hide a warning.

finalCta.title: Your first import starts with a calculation
finalCta.text: Create your account, price an opportunity, then decide. The calculator and the catalogue are free to use before you commit to anything.

journey.title: Between your order and your shop
journey.text: Your supplier does not ship to your door. They deliver to a consolidation warehouse in China, which groups, loads and follows the goods through customs.
journey.cta: See the address to give my supplier

order.title: You order and pay in stages
order.text: Deposit, production, balance after inspection. Every payment is tied to a proof.

warehouse.title: The supplier delivers to the warehouse in China
warehouse.text: With your client code on the cartons: that is what links the parcel to your account.

consolidate.title: Your parcels are grouped and shipped
consolidate.text: Sea, air or express, depending on weight, volume and how fast you need it.

customs.title: The file clears customs
customs.text: Invoice, packing list, tariff classification. An incomplete file is paid for in days of storage.

deliver.title: You collect, or you are delivered
deliver.text: In Douala or Yaoundé, depending on what your forwarder serves.
